subject: Billing cadence & PO requirements — counterproposal on Net terms
messages:
From: Susan Matthews <susan.matthews@greenline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@greenline.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal — PO & billing cadence questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the proposal and the updated pricing spreadsheet — appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement at Greenline has two standard constraints we need to confirm before we can issue an official PO: 1) they require a signed PO that references our internal milestone codes, and 2) our finance team prefers Net60 for third-party SaaS contracts of this size.

A couple of clarifying items from their note: can Redwood accept Net60 (instead of Net30/Net45), and will you accept a monthly invoice cadence with invoice lines mapped to the PO milestones? They also asked for a completed W-9 and the invoice remit details to match the PO exactly.

If Net60 is a hard no, can you propose an alternative billing cadence (e.g., monthly invoicing with 50% upfront and remainder on delivery of milestones) so I can escalate to Finance?

Attached: Greenline-PO-template.docx (procurement wants us to populate your vendor fields).

Thanks — Susan
--
Susan Matthews
Senior Procurement Manager | Greenline Logistics
SM: 415-555-0124
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Matthews <susan.matthews@greenline.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — PO & billing cadence questions

Hi Susan — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear summary. Quick response to each ask:

- Signed PO: yes, we can accept a completed PO referencing your milestone codes. Please send the filled template (we received it) and we will return a countersigned copy.
- W-9: attached to this reply.
- Net terms: our standard hosted contracts default to Net30, with some flexibility for Net45 for committed reserved capacity customers. Net60 is outside standard terms for new accounts because of cash flow and banking limits on monthly invoicing for usage-based plans.

That said, I want to be pragmatic — here are two options we can accept to move forward this week:
1) Net45 with monthly invoices mapped to PO milestones (preferred compromise).
2) Net60 but with a staged invoice cadence: 30% upfront on PO issue, 40% on acceptance of the first milestone (integration complete), and the remainder on go-live — all invoices still referenced to the PO codes.

I've looped in Grace from Finance and Marissa from Legal on the CC to confirm the mechanics and any required Docusign flow. If either option works for Greenline, I can prepare a short amendment to the quote and get it countersigned.

Attachments: Redwood-W9.pdf, Redwood-quote-20260315.xlsx

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
M: 415-555-0198
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Greenline PO terms (Net60 ask)

Ben — quick internal note to confirm: I looked over the quote and the customer profile. Finance will accept Net45 as standard for a deal of this size; Net60 can be considered but Finance will require a partial up-front payment to mitigate AR risk and will flag for rev ops to ensure billing cadence maps to PO lines. For Net60 with no upfront, we'd need a finance approval (likely escalation to VP of Finance).

Marissa: legal ok with countersigning the PO provided the payment schedule is explicitly enumerated and the PO references our standard terms (attached clause set). Karthik: FYI for any SOC/compliance holds — no additional asks from procurement.

If you want, Ben, I can draft the amendment with the staged schedule (option 2 in your email) so Susan has language she can take to Greenline Finance.

Grace
Director of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@greenline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Susan Matthews <susan.matthews@greenline.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — PO & billing cadence questions

Ben / Susan — thanks for the alternatives. Greenline can accept Net45 in most cases, but the budget owner on this line is pushing for Net60 to align with their vendor calendar.

We are willing to accept your staged schedule (option 2) if Redwood can accept Net60 on the back half of payments (i.e., invoice terms for the 40% + 30% split can be Net60) — effectively, we need cashflow relief while still honoring an upfront payment. Would Redwood accept: 30% due on PO (Net30), 40% due on milestone 1 (Net60), 30% due on go-live (Net60)? Also, can you confirm that invoices will include the PO milestone codes and that Redwood can send a single consolidated invoice per milestone (not multiple line-item invoices)?

If you can confirm, I can pull procurement signatures and issue the PO today.

Thanks — Tom
Procurement Director | Greenline Logistics
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@greenline.com>, Susan Matthews <susan.matthews@greenline.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — Redwood accepts staged Net60 cadence (confirming invoicing mechanics)

Tom / Susan — we can accept the split you proposed with the invoice-term mix you suggested: 30% on PO (Net30), then 40% and 30% invoiced at milestone completion with Net60 terms for those two invoices. Redwood will: 

- Provide a countersigned PO referencing your milestone codes.
- Submit invoices consolidated at the milestone level (one invoice per milestone) and include the PO code per invoice line.
- Provide the W-9 and vendor remit details as previously attached.

Marissa / Grace: please note we are finalizing the amendment to the quote with the staged schedule; I'll route for countersignatures once Marissa confirms the language. If there's anything else finance/legal need to capture (late fee language, early-pay discounts) let me know and I will include it.

Susan/Tom: once we have the countersigned PO and payment schedule in the amendment, I'll trigger the onboarding kickoff and schedule the integration milestone review. Appreciate the flexibility — we can get this across the line today.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
